name: Smell of Blood
original_name: スメル オブ ブラッド
source:
Year 2270. Glen is a worker who returns from a 6 month shift from Mars. He awakes in Shuttle 2 only  to find out that the spacecraft is breached by alien killer monsters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-may-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2270年，工人格伦结束在火星为期六个月的轮班工作，踏上返程。他在2号航天飞机中醒来，却发现飞船已经遭外星杀戮怪物入侵。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-may-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
